text:
olivia_pm: FYI — starting a compact Q3 DevEx roadmap thread. Goal: pick top 3 launches (SDKs, quickstarts, sample apps) + 2 ops improvements. Meeting Monday 10am PT. Draft asks:
- Customer features: async SDK request batching, telemetry hooks for cost breakdown
- Launchables: JS SDK v2 GA, 3 quickstarts (chat, embeddings, reranking), sample app: multi-tenant notes
- Cleanups: docs search, sample infra template

Please react with priorities and constraints.

kevin_dev: +1 to async batching. Critical for Platform X pilot (customer 'Atlas'). We should estimate effort: 2 sprints + infra changes.

maria_docs: Docs search needs infra help. If we shift one quickstart to Q4 we can ship better guides + tests.

tariq_ml: Telemetry hooks: we can surface token-level cost with small runtime change. 3 days prototype.

sam_sre: Infra: need to budget for increased e2e tests for GA. Suggest gating JS SDK GA on 95% e2e pass rate and latency SLIs. Also propose rollout canary to 10% traffic.

devex-bot: Reminder: OKR window closes in 9 days. Add items to roadmap doc: <https://docs.redwood.ai/devex/q3-roadmap>

olivia_pm: Proposed priority order: 1) JS SDK v2 GA (critical customers), 2) async batching (performance/cost), 3) telemetry hooks. Quickstarts = ship 2 in Q3 (chat + embeddings), hold reranking for Q4. Thoughts?

kevin_dev: Agree on order. For async batching, can we reuse existing batcher infra? If yes, effort drops to 1 sprint.

maria_docs: I'll draft condensed quickstarts for chat + embeddings with runnable code samples. Need owners for sample app.

tariq_ml: I can own telemetry prototype. If approved, will hand off to kevin for integration.

sam_sre: Approve canary plan. For GA criteria add: security review complete, perf regression <5%, docs + samples included.

olivia_pm: OK — action items:
- kevin_dev: scope async batching + estimate by Thu
- tariq_ml: telemetry prototype by Wed
- maria_docs: drafts for 2 quickstarts by Fri
- sam_sre: define GA test checklist by Thu
I'll update the roadmap doc and tag these under 'Committed Q3'.

kevin_dev: noted.

maria_docs: noted, will ping for reviews.

olivia_pm: thanks — will bring to roadmap sync on Mon. :party_parrot:
